svg.title: Declared packing contract: 277 bytes, 2216 positions
svg.desc: Original conceptual diagram. Positions 0 through 2047 contain the declared Morgan block; position 2048 is unused MACCS key zero; positions 2049 through 2214 contain declared MACCS keys 1 through 166; position 2215 is final padding. Both unused positions must be zero. Bit order must be declared, and real producer eligibility remains unknown. This is not a measured result or a chemical definition.

g.text: A layout contract, not a fingerprint generator or proof of producer compatibility
Blocks above are schematic, not drawn in proportion. Python ranges exclude the right endpoint.
big: key 0 is byte 256 mask 0x80; padding byte 276 mask 0x01
little: key 0 is byte 256 mask 0x01; padding byte 276 mask 0x80
One row order through the entire window
mass axis + unique tokens + packed rows → same inclusive slice
true logits → valid-bit scores → top k with complete tie sizes
Unknown producer or packing: refuse use. Invented fixtures and passing mechanics controls establish no model-quality gain.
